PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-51
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 18-735
CALL TO ORDER (7:30 PM)
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
i.
Introduction & Presentation of NART (Neighborhood Amateur Radio Team)
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 9a-e)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #9a-e) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
(Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.)
1.
Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
October 23, 2018; Regular Meeting
b.
October 30, 2018; Special Meeting
c.
October 30, 2018; Special Joint Meeting
Minutes
2.
Demands of November 13, 2018
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of November 2, 2018
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of November 13, 2018
Demands
3.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
4.
Special Event Application of the Malaga Bank Tree Lighting Ceremony at Malaga Cove Plaza on December 2, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application to allow Malaga Bank to hold and sponsor a Tree Lighting Ceremony in Malaga Cove Plaza parking lot on Sunday, December 2, 2018, from 6:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m.
Staff Report
5.
Approval of Contract with Dude Solutions for Work and Asset Management Software
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with Dude Solutions and authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement.
Staff Report
6.
Expenditure of Citizen's Options for Public Safety (COPS) Funds and Adoption of Resolution R18-49 Authorizing the Expenditure of COPS Funds
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt R18-49, approving the use of COPS funds and approve the expenditure of $5,750 of COPS funds to purchase an emergency call back system and enhanced community notification platform/subscription.
Staff Report
7.
Consideration of Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans, LLP.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 2 with White Nelson Diehl Evans, LLP for City audit services through the fiscal year ending June 30, 2020.
Staff Report
8.
Adoption of Resolution R18-50; Approving the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Estates Public Service Employees Association
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R18-50 approving the Memorandum of Understanding amending the terms and conditions of employment for members of the Public Service Employees Association effective November 26, 2018.
Staff Report
9.
Planning Commission Actions of October 16, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
a.
M-1285-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 136 Rocky Point Road. Lot 67, Tract 717606. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Brad Dudley
345 Third St.
Laguna Beach, CA 92651
Owner: Mark & Heidi Sampson
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Criley abstained) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) A new driveway approach shall be constructed, per City standards. 2) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (basketball hoop system, dirt path, etc.).
b.
NC-1639-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new deck, covered loggia & remodeling located at 2449 Via Sonoma. Lot 8, Block 4, Tract 7538. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Jeffrey Dahl
1102 Main St
Huntington Beach, CA 92648
Owner: Tracy Blanton
22154 E. Mercer Pl.
Aurora, CO 60078
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Criley abstained) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (PVE stone along driveway, etc.)
c.
NC-1634-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new second story deck at the single family residence located at 615 Palos Verdes Drive West. Lot 18, Block 1426, Tract 8523. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Todd & Brigid Becker
Actions: Approved the application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The existing driveway approaches are not constructed to current standards. The approaches shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City Engineer. 2) The existing curb shall be removed and constructed per city standards. 3) The existing trees between the driveway aprons shall be removed. A Brazilian pepper tree shall be planted in between the aprons as approved by the City Engineer.
d.
NC-1636-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions & remodeling at the single family residence located at 789 Via Somonte. Lot 19, Block 1538, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Lane Design Build
2212 Pacific Coast Hwy
Hermosa Beach, CA 90254
Owner: Paul & Nancy Robson
778 Avenue C
Redondo Beach, CA 90277
Actions: Approved the application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (parking pad, rocks, etc.) 2) A new driveway and walkway shall be constructed, per City standards. 3) Curb and gutter shall be constructed, per City standards, along the frontage of the property.
e.
NC-1640/G-1624-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading Applications for a new single family residence located at 508 Via Pena. Lot 8, Block 2225, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Brett Buchmann
746 4th St.
Hermosa Beach, CA 90254
Owner: Gerry Bernhard & Linda Martin
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Criley abstained) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: The new driveway, walkway and Hollywood berm shall be constructed, per City standards at discretion of the City Engineer. The Planning Commission did not approve the stairs within the public right-of-way.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
NEW BUSINESS
10.
Consideration of Options for Maintaining the Mirlo Gate Tower House at 4420 Via Valmonte
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for maintaining the Mirlo Gate Tower House located at 4420 Via Valmonte and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
11.
Consideration of the Palos Verdes Golf Club 2019 Proposed Operating and Capital Budgets, Adjustments to the 2018 Capital Improvement Fund Budget, 2018 Projected Fiscal Results, and Direction in Regard to Extending the Concession Agreement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the 2019 operating and capital budgets of the Palos Verdes Golf Club, approve the 2018 Capital Improvement Fund budget adjustments, and provide direction in reference to returning with a 20-year Concession Agreement extension.
Staff Report
12.
Determination of an Evaluation Process of Stable Concession Proposals for the Selection of a Concessionaire
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the recommended process for evaluating proposals, selecting a Concessionaire, and negotiating a Concession Agreement.
Staff Report
13.
Consideration of Finance Advisory Committee Recommendation for Change in Meeting Venue and Recording of Meetings
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the Finance Advisory Committee conducting meetings at the Palos Verdes Golf Club or locations other than the City Hall Council Chambers, and the off-site meetings being audio or video recorded.
Staff Report
14.
Quarterly Report of Cash & Investments - September 30, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
15.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
16.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 27, 2018, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
i.
